However, E1 does not involve controlled low-O2 annealing, Cu enrichment, or grain refinement. E2 demonstrates inverse Hall–Petch behavior and low friction in a different HEA (CoCrFeMnNi) under vacuum, but it explicitly avoids oxidation and does not link the effect to an oxide layer. Thus, the key premises linking controlled oxidation to grain refinement and improved wear resistance are not supported by the cited
